skills.name: route_to_model
skills.description: Send a message to another AI model and get its response. Use this when asked to communicate with, ask, or delegate to another model (e.g., 'tell sonnet to...', 'ask opus about...').

model.description: The model to route to: sonnet, opus, haiku, ollama

message.description: The message to send to the target model

skills.name: search_ideas
skills.description: Search the idea database for previously discussed ideas, questions, decisions, and action items. Use this when asked to recall, find, or look up past ideas or discussions.

query.description: Search query — matches against idea names and descriptions

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

skills.name: get_node_details
skills.description: Get full details of a specific node including its attributes and children. Use this to inspect a particular idea, thread, or conversation node in depth.

node_id.description: The UUID of the node to retrieve

include_children.description: Whether to include child nodes (default: true)

skills.name: orchestrate
skills.description: Create a project in the orchestration engine, generate a plan, and optionally start execution. Use this when asked to build, implement, or execute a multi-step task that should be planned and dispatched to AI agents.

requirements.description: What needs to be built or done — detailed requirements

repo_path.description: Working directory / repository path for the project

rigor.description: Planning rigor level: L0 (roadmap), L1 (quick), L2 (standard), L3 (thorough)

auto_start.description: Whether to auto-approve the plan and start execution (default: false)

skills.name: list_threads
skills.description: List open conversation threads with their status and recent activity. Use this when asked about ongoing conversations, active topics, or what's being discussed.

status.description: Filter by status: open, parked, all (default: open)

limit.description: Maximum number of threads to return (default: 10)
